audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose leans on Defiant Dance as the answer to Ahri's burst. It is not: W reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge and Ahri deals magic (and true, on Orb of Deception's return).
audit.why: Riot text on Irelia W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Ahri Q flag: trueDamage on the way back. So the entire lane is decided by dodging Charm, not by absorbing damage.
audit.corrected: Lane is even-to-slightly-losing (48.75% over 2447 games). You win by sidestepping Charm behind minions and stunning her exit, not by tanking through W.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] credits Vanguard's Edge at Level 3; the ultimate does not exist until 6.
audit.why: Level 3 spike is Flawless Duet (E) completing the stun-into-reset engine, cooldown 16s at rank 1. Level 6 is Vanguard's Edge (R, 125s at rank 1) walling her Spirit Rush exit. First item is the Sheen/BORK reset spike. Ahri's spikes: Charm at 1 (flat 12s), Level 6 Spirit Rush (140s, three dashes), and Essence Theft sustain per 9 minions.
audit.corrected: Level 3 = Flawless Duet stun engine; Level 6 = Vanguard's Edge walls the escape; first item = reset kill threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Charm 'instantly stops movement abilities', so it cancels Bladesurge mid-dash. Conversely Flawless Duet grounds, which denies Spirit Rush's dashes, and Vanguard's Edge creates terrain that blocks her exit path.
audit.why: enemyKit E text states movement abilities are stopped outright; ownerKit E carries the grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes'); ownerKit R carries the terrain flag ('creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes').
audit.corrected: Do not Q into a held Charm — it eats the dash. Stun her when Spirit Rush is committed, and drop the R wall behind her rather than in front.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no numeric cooldown at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Charm is a flat 12s at every rank, Orb of Deception a flat 7s, Spirit Rush 140/120/100.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Essence Theft sustain.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule needs-antiheal; enemyKit P heals on 9 minions and on takedowns.
packet suspectNames flagged 'Vanguard's Edge' and 'Orb of Deception' — both are the real Riot names. False positives, no change made.
